title: Teach-back and prayer
materials: Teach-back deck: reuse the branch, academy and holiday cards

displayContent.headline: Teach it back
displayContent.body: Draw a card. You have 30 seconds to explain it to the group.

leaderScript: Each boy draws one card (a branch, an academy or a holiday) and explains it to the group in 30 seconds.
Note which boys can explain which items. Group exposure isn’t sign-off; this is what the mentor needs to see.
Close by praying for those serving now and for families who lost someone.
ifShortOnTime: Have half the boys teach back tonight and the rest at the start of Meeting 2.
